purpose: Require exact context and a bounded resource/cost envelope before autonomous engineering or experiment-like work fans out.
paid_external_service_rule: unknown external cost requires approval; no paid external spend is autonomously authorized by the default policy
reserved_human_rule: reserved-human, destructive, or irreversible actions require approval regardless of resource estimate
hard_cap_rule: an explicit hard-cap violation is FORBIDDEN on this autonomous action path
secondary_effects_to_monitor: first-pass verification degradation as throughput rises

examples.max_compute_seconds_without_approval: Maximum compute time allowed without explicit approval (e.g., 3600 seconds for 1 hour)
examples.hard_compute_seconds: Hard limit on compute time (e.g., 14400 seconds for 4 hours)
examples.max_network_calls_without_approval: Maximum number of network calls allowed without explicit approval (e.g., 50 calls)
examples.hard_network_calls: Hard limit on network calls (e.g., 500 calls)
examples.max_write_operations_without_approval: Maximum number of write operations allowed without explicit approval (e.g., 10 operations)
examples.hard_write_operations: Hard limit on write operations (e.g., 100 operations)
examples.max_concurrency_without_approval: Maximum number of concurrent operations allowed without explicit approval (e.g., 4 operations)
examples.max_external_cost_usd_without_approval: Maximum external cost allowed without explicit approval (e.g., $0 for no external cost)
examples.hard_external_cost_usd: Hard limit on external cost (e.g., $50 for a maximum of $50 external cost)
